claim: LLMs have limited numerical sensitivity, struggling to reliably distinguish small but important differences in metrics such as CPU utilization percentages.
falsifier: Design experiments where LLMs are given pairs of metric values with small differences and measure classification accuracy; compare to human or statistical baselines.

conditions: when processing numerical metrics such as CPU utilization percentages
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Numerical sensitivity of LLMs–ability to distinguish small principle
